body:
The session ran the one fresh-agent cold-agent live run over 0.3.0's seven stand apps under the founder's 5 % wrong-call bar and stated its result as measured.
Measured: 76 tool calls, 0 wrong, seven apps, fifteen tools, client 2.1.327; graph, actions, layout, lint, screenshot and advance read once each, 3 list openings, every refusal cause 0, one panic, one error and one log caused-by kind.
It changed no code line: the pipe's bar, prompt, counted sets and verdict are byte-equal; only comments, the readme's 0.3.0 heading and closing paragraph, and the capability page's measured-instance and reach paragraphs moved.
It retired the interim 0.3.0 heading and its 16 of 17 verified sentence (now all 17 verified), and the capability page's 2026-10-25 run as the measured instance (kept as the earlier run).
The take-up's credential probe was revised so it reads a key name carrying a value, never the client's apiKeySource field name; the transcript evidence stays byte-faithful.

body_fields.what: the cold-agent pipe — the fresh-agent run over the stand apps through the driver's MCP server, its wrong-call bar and verdict; comment lines alone changed
the project readme — its 0.3.0 version heading and the closing paragraph stating how many capabilities are verified and the measured cold-agent run

the capability statement page — its section on what an MCP client carries onward: the measured cold-agent instance, the reach (the out-of-reach capabilities with their stand witnesses) and the earlier runs

body: The capability statement's reach paragraph was edited by hand, restating the out-of-reach capabilities with their stand witnesses; a rule that accessibility reach on the capability page is edited by hand rules over that edit.

The reach stated on the capability page sits beside the absence of a platform accessibility adapter in any stand binary, so no assistive technology is given a tree; the restated reach must still agree with it.

The founder's F4 ratifies graph and actions answers crossing to the model provider on the live run; rules that the UI graph is read-only and carries no values, and that the actions verb changes nothing, bound what crossed.
The live run counted refusals by cause, every cause 0; the actions answer's causes and the driver refusal causes (disabled, covered) are the set it counted against.

The live run sent the snapshot readings of the seven apps to the provider in its transcript; the rules that password text is never revealed and a password value is masked govern what that transcript may carry.

The cold-agent bar requires a list opening (3 measured); the absence of a snapshot reading of whether a list is open, and a single select's expanded state read from its list, are what an agent reads that opening by.

The run's readers (snapshot, graph, actions, layout, lint, screenshot) read one snapshot model over the accessibility tree; rules that the snapshot reads the tree and that its readers share one model sit under what the run measured, unchanged.
The stand's lint was read once by the agent with no finding counted wrong; the rule that the stand reads no lint finding at boot is what that read stands on.
Keyboard navigation contracts and decisions (Tab order, select list keys, range input keys, cells grid and CRUD list keys, keyboard activation): no key behaviour moved.
ARIA role mapping, ARIA property and state reads, accessible name precedence and hidden or inert content rules: no tree-building rule moved.
AccessKit adapter, platform adapter and accessibility feature defaults: no feature, dependency or adapter changed.
Contrast thresholds, the contrast lint finding's fields, stand colours and select list visuals: no style or lint rule moved.
The a11y CI leg, the accessibility test leg and the three-round stand checks: CI ran green 17 of 17 with no leg, tier or gate changed.
Cognitive accessibility rows (invalid state beyond colour or class, shared stand focus order table): no stand app or its expectations moved.

The session fired the one live cold-agent run of 0.3.0 once, over the seven served stand apps, under the founder's 5 % wrong-call bar, and stated its result as measured.
Measured: verdict passed, 76 tool calls over fifteen tools, 0 wrong, client 2.1.327, every graph, actions, layout, lint, screenshot and advance tool used, caused_by_kind panic 1, error 1, log 1, every refusal cause 0, $1.03 of the $3 cap.
The front page's 0.3.0 heading now reads the version built with its cold-agent run passed, and all 17 of its capabilities verified, replacing the interim heading and the 16 of 17 count.
The capability statement's measured instance moved from the 2026-10-25 run (six apps, twelve tools, 66 calls, client 2.1.308) to this run; the earlier run is kept as one sentence, and the six capabilities outside the run's reach are named with their headless stand witnesses.
No code line moved: the cold-agent pipe changed in a comment alone; its bar, prompt, counted tools, cause kinds, verdict and run arm are unchanged.
Retired: the sentence that no live run had read the seventh app yet.

The provider crossing: the founder's F4 ratifies graph and actions answers reaching the model provider on the live run alone, through the operator's own login; rows that say the graph answer or the actions answer never leaves except in its answer, or that the provider is reached only by the live run, are restated by it.

The committed transcript copies and committed kept checks holding no secrets: the credential probe over the kept live evidence and the capability statement read 0 under its revised arm, a key name carrying a value; the bare field name apiKeySource, written by the client in every init record, is not a credential.
The cold-agent transcript kept raw and unscrubbed: the operator ruled the live evidence stays byte-faithful — the probe changes, never the transcript.
Cold-agent state, server log, client log and kept checks never printed or copied: the live run copied none of them into the evidence; the transcript host-path probe read 0.
The cold-agent verdict holding no content and the cold-agent events carrying no user content: the run's verdict and events were written by an unchanged pipe and kept as evidence.

body_fields.reason: The chunk changes only comment lines of the cold-agent pipe, the README's 0.3.0 heading and closing paragraph, and the capability page's MCP-client section (fct-ylot7xkz, fct-yb6s266b); it adds no UI element and touches no a11y or obs schema (fct-jmbh7lz2, fct-w6qg2fhm), so every a11y-plan row it reaches stays true and neither D-a11y-surface nor D-a11y-obs-schema fires.

body_fields.name: Cold-agent result stated as measured, with its reach
body_fields.rule: The capability statement states a cold-agent result as measured, with its reach: the measured instance names its apps, tools, calls, wrong calls and client, and every capability outside that run's reach is named with its headless stand witness.
body_fields.because: The chunk restated the capability statement's measured cold-agent instance with its apps, tools, calls, wrong calls and client and named each out-of-reach capability with its stand witness, a ratified convention no project-intent row yet says.

body_fields.reason: The chunk moves no code line and adds no surface, region, verb or tool (fct-yb6s266b, fct-jmbh7lz2); its edits are README and capability-page prose of the measured run plus two comment lines of the pipe, so every row stands true — contract/escher-session-mcp/tools' fifteen verbs included, which the measured run's fifteen tools confirm (fct-qqkt3ncp) — and D-layout-surface finds no undocumented surface.

body_fields.name: Cold-agent live run fired once
body_fields.rule: A version's live cold-agent run is fired once under a 3 USD cap and never re-fired, not across a surfaced stop nor a plan revision; another run needs a new ruling.
body_fields.because: The run was held to one firing under the 3 USD cap across its surfaced stop and the plan's revision, a ruled bound on the harness's live run that no standing row of the harness contract states.

body_fields.value: The cold-agent transcript holds raw model output and tool I/O, carried to the model provider, never printed or logged and gitignored under target; its kept live-run evidence stays byte-faithful, a misfiring probe over it revised and the transcript never edited.
body_fields.because: The operator ruled that the kept evidence stays byte-faithful and the probe changes, never the transcript, so the row on the raw transcript must carry that rule.

body_fields.name: Credential probe reads a valued key name
body_fields.rule: A credential probe over a kept agent transcript counts a key name carrying a value, never a bare field name; the client's init field apiKeySource with value none is no credential.
body_fields.why: A field-name pattern matched the client's init field written in every run, so the probe could never read 0 on a real transcript.
body_fields.because: The credential probe over kept transcripts was revised to read a key name carrying a value, a rule for every later probe that no row of the section states.

body_fields.name: Credential probe reads a key carrying a value
body_fields.rule: A credential probe over an agent client's transcript counts a key name carrying a value, never a field name alone, so the client's init field apiKeySource with the value none is no credential.
body_fields.why: A field-name pattern matched the claude client's init field in every run's transcript and could never read clean.
body_fields.guard: the probe's control, planting apiKeySource none as clean and an api_key line with a value as a hit
body_fields.because: The chunk revised the credential probe to read a key name carrying a value after a field-name pattern hit apiKeySource, and no row of Secret Management states how a credential probe reads the evidence.

body_fields.name: Founder's cold-agent live run fired once
body_fields.rule: The founder's live cold-agent run to the model provider is fired once and never re-fired, even across a surfaced stop or a plan revision; a second live run to the provider needs the founder's new word.
body_fields.because: The chunk held the one live run unre-fired across its surfaced stop and the plan's revision, and no row of the provider crossing states that bound on live runs.

body_fields.name: Live cold-agent run fired once per version
body_fields.rule: The live cold-agent run is fired once per version under a 3 USD cap and is never re-fired, not across a surfaced stop nor a plan revision; a second run needs a new ruling.
body_fields.because: The report rules the live run a one-time firing never repeated across a surfaced stop and a plan revision, a decision no standing row of the harness contract states.

body_fields.name: Credential probe reads a key carrying a value
body_fields.rule: A credential probe over an agent client's transcript reads a key name carrying a value, never a field name alone.
body_fields.why: The client writes apiKeySource with value none in every run's init record, so a probe of the field name alone reads every transcript as holding a credential.
body_fields.because: The report revises the credential probe to read a key name carrying a value after the name-only pattern matched the client's init field, a convention binding every later probe over a transcript.

body_fields.name: Live-run evidence transcript kept byte-faithful
body_fields.rule: The live cold-agent run's evidence transcript is kept byte-faithful: a probe that misreads it is changed, never the transcript.
body_fields.because: The report rules that the evidence stays byte-faithful and the probe changes, a decision no standing row of the harness contract states.

body_fields.name: Capability statement states the measured live run
body_fields.rule: The capability statement states the live cold-agent run as measured with its reach: the run's date, app and call counts, wrong calls and client version, and each capability out of its reach named with its stand witness.
body_fields.because: The report has the capability statement carry the measured run's counts and name the out-of-reach capabilities with their stand witnesses, a rule for the statement no standing row of the test strategy states.

body:
The session ran the one fresh-agent cold-agent live run over 0.3.0's seven served apps, under the founder's kept 5 % wrong-call bar, and stated its result as measured: passed, 0 wrong of 76 tool calls, fifteen tools, client claude 2.1.327, through the operator's own login, $1.03 of the $3 cap.
No code line moved: the cold-agent pipe's bar, prompt, call allowlist, counted kinds, causes, verdict and run arm are byte-equal; only two comment lines of the pipe changed.
The measured instance in the capability statement moved from the 2026-10-25 run (six apps, twelve tools, 66 calls, client 2.1.308) to this run; the readme's 0.3.0 heading and closing paragraph now say all 17 capabilities are verified and the cold-agent run passed.
The plan's credential probe over the live evidence was measured unable to read 0: its api-key pattern matched the client's init field name apiKeySource (value none); the probe was revised to read a key name carrying a value, the transcript kept byte-faithful, and the live run never re-fired.
The founder's F1 (keep 5 %), F2 (measured, with reach), F3 (one run, $3 cap) and F4 (graph and actions answers to the provider ratified) are relayed as the basis of this wrap's amendments.

the committed capability statement — its section on what an MCP client carries onward (the MCP crossing to the model provider), the measured cold-agent instance and the capabilities out of a live run's reach with their stand witnesses; edited

body: The cold-agent wrong-call bar: the founder's F1 keeps it at 5 %; the one live run measured 0 wrong of 76 calls under it; a row holding the bar or the measured count is reached.

Live evidence holds no credentials: its credential probe was revised so a key name carrying a value counts and the client's init field name apiKeySource (value none) does not; the probe now reads 0 over the live evidence and the capability statement.
Live runs use the operator's own login: the run reached the model provider once through the operator's Claude Code login, client 2.1.327, model claude-opus-5-5.
Cold-agent runs carry the screen to the provider: F4 ratifies graph and actions answers crossing to the provider on a live run, and F3 bounds it to one run under a $3 cap; the run spent $1.03.
The graph answer crossing and the actions answer crossing: the live run carried both to the provider (one graph call, one actions call) under F4's ratification.

The committed statement of the MCP crossing: its measured instance now names the 2026-11-18 run (seven apps, fifteen tools, 76 calls, 0 wrong, client 2.1.327) and keeps the 2026-10-25 run as the earlier one.
The cold-agent raw transcript kept unscrubbed: the operator ruled the evidence stays byte-faithful — a probe that misreads it changes, never the transcript.
The caused text crossing: the run counted caused_by_kind panic 1, error 1, log 1 over the served error page, and the evidence states refused_by_cause with every cause 0.

Cold-agent checks read for bools and counts only, and the agent-written check validated and replayed on fresh servers: the run's atoms held isolated, counts_agree, recording_kept, check_passed and check_can_fail; no kept check, server log or client log was copied into the evidence.
Kept checks owner-only and uncommitted, and cold-agent recordings private: nothing of the run's kept checks or recordings entered the repository; the pipe's state is left outside it for cleanup.
The cold-agent fixed prompt and the call and task allowlist: unchanged, byte-equal to the base — a row on them stands as written.
The secret-management overview: the run's login is still held by the claude CLI; the probe's credential reading changed from a field name to a key name carrying a value.

The founder's live cold-agent run is fired once and never re-fired, even across a surfaced stop or a plan revision; a second live run to the provider needs the founder's new word.
